_comment: Tier-2 for skfem linear_elasticity#1: skfem.models.elasticity.lame_parameters(E, nu) returns (lam, mu) equal to the textbook formulas to float64 precision, in that ORDER. Swapping the unpacking order is silent for nu near 1/3 only by coincidence; at nu=0.3 the two differ by ~1.5x. Also pins the nu->0.5 blow-up. Measured on skfem 12.0.1.
